media.title: Ich steh im Schnee und wart auf dich — Gloria-Tanz-Orchester, listening reference
media.description: Listening reference for “Ich steh' im Schnee und wart' auf dich” in the recording by the Gloria-Tanz-Orchester with refrain vocal. The upload names Otto Dobrindt as the leader and John Hendrik as the singer and dates the recording to 30 January 1931; the label is not shown.
